# video-to-motion-sop

> A workflow (SOP) for turning one performance video into multi-angle AI video: the performer's motion is recovered frame by frame as 3D (SMPL-X), rendered as a "clay" reference from any camera, then re-skinned by Seedance 2.5 in EDIT mode (motion and camera inherited frame by frame). Unified motion, any angle, any world — unlike tools that repaint the original footage from its single camera. Author: 爽哥说. License: CC BY 4.0. Documents are in Chinese.

## For agents
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the execution handbook — invariants, questions to ask the human, data contracts, per-step parameters and thresholds, Seedance request body, sync-mapping algorithm, failure table, cost estimator.

- [02 动作提取与身份锁定](docs/02-动作提取与身份锁定.md): 2D pose, tracking, identity lock
- [03 3D动作复原](docs/03-3D动作复原.md): GVHMR, per-frame SMPL-X whole-body fitting, foot contact
- [04 动作优化与合并](docs/04-动作优化与合并.md): motion master, gap filling, local motion edits (IK)
- [05 Clay动作参考与机位](docs/05-Clay动作参考与机位.md): clay figure, camera keys, vertical safe-band fitting
- [06 多角度AI视频生成](docs/06-多角度AI视频生成.md): Seedance edit mode, references, prompt structure, pricing
- [07 对齐后期交付](docs/07-对齐后期交付.md): sync mapping, grading, upscaling, FX, packaging, loudness
